title: Desert monsters rebuilt in 3D
changes: The Sunscar's nomads, sand-dead, Veiled adepts, camel-folk, sphinx warriors and the Sunwright are now built as 3D models and drawn as pixel art: long robes that sway, the sphinx's striped royal headcloth and folded golden wings, the camel-folk's heads and capes.
Robed beast-folk of the Mawdeep (crow seer, weaver, Hide-Mother) now wear their full robes too. Same size on screen and no cost to performance.
